name: avatar
props: Image URL. Fades in over the initials; falls back to them on error.
Initials, the deterministic fallback colour and the accessibility label.
Circle or rounded square (follows the kit radius).
Soft tint with deep ink, flat fill, or an opt-in two-tone gradient.
Presence dot in a ring cut-out: filled, crescent, bar, hollow.
Soft pulse behind the dot (off with reduce motion).
Solid accent ring with a clear gap. "seen" = story + seen.
Story watched: the ring cross-fades to a quiet hairline.
Ring colour override; the first entry is used as a solid colour.
Broken ring that spins — a loading story (circle only).
Rosette seal with a check, bottom-right (bottom-left if a status dot is shown).
Notification count (99+), or true for a dot, top-right.
Colour behind the avatar; cut-outs and group borders use it.
Soft drop shadow under the face.
Makes it a button with spring press feedback.
Real total when larger than what you pass.
Overlap as a fraction of the size.
Colour of the separating borders — match the parent.
Style for the avatar root; AvatarGroup applies it to its row.
